annotations.title: Turn daily guides on or off

description: Turns daily guides on or off for one app's website. On needs the website verified, in a connected Google Search Console, and a plan that includes them; the error says which is missing. Each morning after that, Apptiller writes at most one guide, only when a search is worth one, and pauses while 3 wait unpublished.
name: set_site_guides
title: Turn daily guides on or off
